items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: And now, Harry Fagli too, he's playing banjo.

ctx.x: Oh, I never did get much more about Clara Statham. You said they had Raymond Brown and George McCullum. And myself. And?
And now, Harry Fagli too, he's playing banjo.
I'm going to see him Sunday if I can. Where? Over the Lake? Over the Lake Harrow and I'm supposed to drive over there. Oh yeah?
